legal_route.criterion: Original base strip x[.8,2.2],abs(y)<=.6 and actual interior-foot Fz>0 at500Hz; return uses reversed boundaries. Signed credit is provisional and retracted on illegal/incomplete passage. New R12 mission evaluation also checks these recorded legal roundtrips.

material_traversal.measurement: First outbound base-projection passage from the west to east strip boundary without a side exit, with actual material-loaded feet during that passage. Uses original strip geometry and500Hz recorded states; no extra physical termination threshold or route change.

work_scope: Only completed native call records; interrupted calls with no record have unknown unrecorded native rollout work, never inferred zero.

external_snapshot_scope.limitations: Native optimizer caches, actor tensors/RNG and arbitrary Python objects are not an automatic mid-episode resume; fixed checkpoint/resume remain separate.

causal_conclusion: Original task status above; nonzero prediction error and diagnostic thresholds do not by themselves identify the cause of failure.
support_scope: Descriptive gait/support evidence, not altered original task qualification. Survival is not stable locomotion.

gait_and_support.force_sample_clock: trajectory 500Hz same-time mj_forward force; first_nonfoot_load event retains 5000Hz detection time
gait_and_support.full_record_observed_source: original evaluator stage_progress.full_observation; early-ended result is not automatically full observation

windows.feet_z_semantics: recorded geom centers minus original compiled foot radii; relative to original z=0 plane, not unobserved deformed terrain
windows.support_pattern_bits: FL=1, FR=2, RL=4, RR=8; load threshold is descriptive 1N

full_trajectory_analysis.scope: Full actual trajectory, all physical rows, all applied queries, all active seed metadata; all retained valid-S candidate epochs. No new physics.

resources.scope: waited child tree CPU time; max RSS is maximum individual child, not concurrent sum
